decision.explanation: The question asks who Anne Wodehouse's spouse is. Two distinct claims appear in the provided documents. Document d1 (D1S2) explicitly states that Anne Wodehouse married Carole Madge Warrand de Montmorency. Document d2 (D2S3) states that Anne Wodehouse married James Carleton King. These are two separate historical accounts involving the same name 'Anne Wodehouse,' but they describe different marriages to different spouses. Since the documents do not clarify whether these refer to the same Anne Wodehouse or different individuals with the same name, both answers are preserved as valid referents. There is no evidence in the provided material to resolve the contradiction definitively.
